newsitem.title: FRANCE: St Gobain firms on bullish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: St Gobain firms on bullish sentiment.

text.p: Shares in glass company Saint Gobain were up 3.7 percent at 869 francs, on volume of 264,200 shares at 1120 GMT, on Wednesday.

Traders said the market was hoping for "good news" from the annual shareholders meeting due to start at 1300 GMT today. A broker said the last time chairman Jean-Louis Beffa spoke to analysts, he said he expected price rises in flat glass. The broker added first quarter turnover figures, on a comparable basis excluding Poliet, had been "excellent".
But it was unlikely Beffa, known for his cautious outlook, would make a detailed profit forecast, the broker said.
Beffa said on April 1 that he expected Saint-Gobain's net profit to increase by at least 20 percent for 1997. The company posted 1996 net income of 4.32 billion francs.
